effects.description: [On Play] Up to 1 of your Leader gains +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
conditions: This Character is played onto the field
steps: That Leader gains +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn
notes: This effect activates automatically when this Character is played
You can choose not to give the bonus to any Leader

effects.description: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters -1000 power during this turn.
conditions: This Character has 1 DON!! card attached
steps: (Optional) Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Characters
That Character gets -1000 power during this turn
notes: This effect happens automatically when this Character attacks with 1 DON!! attached
You can choose not to use this effect even if there is a valid target
The power reduction lasts until the end of this turn
